caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or plate oriented so that it appears as a circle on a neutral background. The dish is decorated with an intricate symmetrical design. At its center is a circular motif composed of radial segments in green and reddish-brown alternating patterns, surrounded by a sawtooth border in similar shades. Radiating outward are green leaves, interspersed with reddish-brown and yellow accents. On the wider surface of the plate, there are four stylized floral designs evenly spaced; two at the top feature red tulip-like flowers with yellow details, and two at the sides feature blue and green flowers with yellow centers, all attached to winding green stems with multiple green leaves. Near the upper center, above the central motif, the year "1793" is written in brown. The overall color palette includes various shades of green, brown, red, yellow, and blue set against a beige or tan background. The rim of the plate is outlined in a darker brown. The lower right edge features a signature in brown ink.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
